an entry is expired\n    once ``clock() >= expires_at``.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, capacity, ttl=None, clock=time.monotonic):\n        if capacity < 1:\n            raise ValueError(\"capacity must be >= 1\")\n        self.capacity = capacity\n        self.ttl = ttl\n        self.clock = clock\n        self._data = OrderedDict()  # key -> (value, expires_at)\n\n    def _expired(self, expires_at, now):\n        return self.ttl is not None and now >= expires_at\n\n    def _drop_expired(self, now):\n        if self.ttl is None:\n            return\n        for key in [k for k, (_, exp) in self._data.items() if now >= exp]:\n            del self._data[key]\n\n    def get(self, key, default=None):\n        now = self.clock()\n        try:\n            value, expires_at = self._data[key]\n        except KeyError:\n            return default\n        if self._expired(expires_at, now):\n            del self._data[key]\n            return default\n        self._data.move_to_end(key)\n        return value\n\n    def put(self, key, value):\n        now = self.clock()\n        self._drop_expired(now)\n        expires_at = now + self.ttl if self.ttl is not None else math.inf\n        if key in self._data:\n            del self._data[key]\n        self._data[key] = (value, expires_at)\n        while len(self._data) > self.capacity:\n            self._data.popitem(last=False)\n\n    def __len__(self):\n        now = self.clock()\n        if self.ttl is None:\n            return len(self._data)\n        return sum(1 for (_, exp) in self._data.values() if now < exp)\n\n    def __contains__(self, key):\n        entry = self._data.get(key)\n        if entry is None:\n            return False\n        return not self._expired(entry[1], self.clock())\n"}"]]}
